name: NoveLand for Writers
original_description:
NoveLand is a writing tool built for working with AI, specialized in storytelling such as novels and scripts. It has everything you need to create stories while consulting with AI: a design that lets AI read your story accurately, and diagrams that let you grasp the flow of your story at a glance, supporting your everyday writing.

Works, story details, and relationship diagrams you create in ChatGPT open as they are in the NoveLand web editor, where you can keep writing them yourself. Within the same work, you can move freely between the parts you leave to AI and the parts you write yourself.
More about the editor: https://novel-land.com/editor-introduction

■ AI that can draw on your story details when answering
To create a story together with AI, the AI also needs to read information beyond the body text, such as your characters' personalities and worldbuilding details.
NoveLand links the body text to the relevant story details, so AI can choose and read only the details it needs. You can discuss your writing with an AI that understands your story more deeply.

■ See your story as diagrams
Relationship diagrams, graphs that show the direction of relationships, timelines of events, family trees, and charts of per-episode figures appear as diagrams right in the conversation. You can grasp the whole story without comparing long passages of text, and spot structural imbalances or missing relationships at a glance.

■ A foundation for manga and anime scripts
The body text is structured as narration, dialogue tagged with speakers, and scene breaks, the same structure as a script or screenplay. For people who create manga or anime with AI, NoveLand also serves as a foundation for scripts that lets you manage characters, story details, and episodes together.

■ What you can do from ChatGPT
・Create and edit works, chapters, and episodes
・Register and organize characters, terms, and reference documents
・Create relationship diagrams, and display timelines, family trees, and other diagrams
・Register foreshadowing and keep track of the episodes where it pays off
・Search the body text, and display episode lists and body text previews
